scenes: one point five billion dollars vanished from a crypto exchange in February twenty twenty-five.
Dubai based exchange Bye-bit suffered the one point five billion dollar theft by Lazarus hackers, marking the largest cryptocurrency theft on record.
Hackers rushed to launder hundreds of millions through Bitcoin mixers fast while C E O Ben Zhou reported ongoing recovery challenges.
Investigator Zack X B T secretly infiltrated a Chinese laundering crew moving the funds after spending months posing as a paying client.
But that is not even the strangest part of this story.
In August twenty twenty-six, Bye-bit officially sued North Korea in court, targeting the state-sanctioned hacking organization and intelligence agency.
The exchange miraculously secured an early order freezing stolen crypto assets as it chases the funds lost in last year's hack.
Proving even billion-dollar state hackers leave a trail to follow.
